directions.name: 连续文章式
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished Chinese MOBILE concept reader visual concept for 银河AI知识图册. One portrait phone viewport, no hardware frame or desktop page, no long poster. Design for 390px CSS width with legible 16px+ body text proportions. Invent typography, palette, materials and icon style freely; the layout strategy below is the distinguishing requirement. The first screen is text-led and includes a SMALL volumetric connected-node graph thumbnail entrance, opening a separate full 3D network view. Internal concept numbers are invisible. Graph thumbnail has no topology labels. No extra relationship explanation panel.
Use these exact facts only:
Concept title 大语言模型. English Large Language Model (LLM). Show 认知层级：理解 as small metadata only; 理解 is NOT a statement that this model understands language. Definition: 在海量文本上训练、以预测词序列下一个单元为目标、具备语言生成与转换能力的大规模参数模型。
Example: 能续写、改写、翻译、摘要的对话模型。
Safety: 模型可能生成不实信息，事实必须人工核查。
Additional reading section labels: 案例、类比、误解、反例、深度、安全、来源. Use labels only for content not shown; don't invent paragraphs. Graph action 查看关系网; neighbor count 41个相邻概念. Search and navigation must be accessible. No invented courses, category tags, completion scores or slogans.
LAYOUT STRATEGY — flowing article, full-width reading: A compact header has search/menu icons. Title, English name, cognition metadata and definition form a single full-width article column. NO graph beside the title. After the definition, a slim in-flow horizontal graph entrance combines a SMALL thumbnail on one end with 查看关系网 and 41个相邻概念; it occupies a modest line of the article, not a large panel. Below, the example continues the prose rhythm, and the other fields are vertical disclosure headings. Navigation is a compact floating contents button. No large card grid, no tabbed reader, no side index. The visual rhythm should unmistakably be continuous document reading.
